overrides.description: Configuration overrides that replace default values when context conditions are met. Keys represent configuration keys and values are the override data.
overrides.title: Overrides

metrics.description: Metric selection update using workspace metric definitions containing name and direction. Omit to preserve the current selection, pass null to clear it, or pass a selection object to replace it. Updates are allowed only while the experiment is in CREATED state.

experiment_group_id.description: To unset experiment group, pass "null" string.
